subject: POC handshake: sprint charter, success metrics, and environment provisioning
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@nimblecare.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimblecare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + next steps (POC handshake) — NimbleCare

Hi Lena / Samir —

Thanks again for a great conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Problem & goal (your phrasing): 
- Primary pain: discharge summary errors and long turnaround for clinician QA on post-visit notes — inconsistent triage across sites. 
- Goal: reduce manual QA time by 40% on average and surface high-risk notes for clinical review within 2 hours.

2) Proposed POC scope (30 days):
- Ingest pipeline: ~50k de-identified notes from two pilot clinics (sample set we discussed).
- Deliverables: prompt bank + eval harness, model serving on Redwood Dedicated, daily quality dashboard.
- Success metrics: precision@top-200 for high-risk flagging >= 0.75; avg inference latency <= 120ms for 256-token requests; ops runbook for fallback behavior.

3) Access & provisioning (action owners):
- NimbleCare IT to create a read-only S3 bucket or temporary SFTP with a service account for data transfer (Samir, action).
- Redwood to provision a Dedicated trial pool in us-west and share deployment hostnames and creds (Aisha / Ben).
- We need a list of 6 prompt-led evaluation examples + expected labels by 01/05.

4) Timeline / handshake:
- 12/24 — SOW + charter (we’ll attach a v1 for review).
- 01/04 — Environment ready + data placed in bucket.
- 01/06 — Kickoff run: first ingestion + baseline eval.

Attachments: nimblecare-poc-charter-v1.pdf (draft), scope sheet stub.

A couple of clarifications we promised on the call:
- We can support HIPAA-compliant transfers and will offer an NDA addendum for the POC.
- Our defaults will run quantized model variants for cost-savings; we’ll document any delta in quality.

Next steps: Samir — can you confirm the S3 vs SFTP preference and target owner? Lena — can you confirm the 2 pilot clinics and the sample owner for labeling?

Thanks,

Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@nimblecare.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimblecare.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps (POC handshake) — NimbleCare

Thanks Aisha —

This lines up with our notes. Quick answers:
- We prefer an S3 bucket (read-only IAM role) scoped to a nimblecare-poc prefix; Samir will create the role by 12/29.
- Pilot clinics: Willowbrook and East Bay Urgent Care; clinical lead for labeling is Dr. Priya Nair (priya.nair@nimblecare.com).
- We can provide the 6 evaluation examples by 01/04; we'll also include the gold-labels.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you share the expected data schema (fields + sample transformation steps)?
2) Who will be our main technical contact at Redwood for the environment provisioning questions?

Samir / Dr. Nair — looping you in.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Director, Clinical Innovation | NimbleCare Health

Samir / Lena —

Thanks for the SOC2 extract — helpful. For the IAM role we typically request:
- s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket on the nimblecare-poc prefix
- Optionally, sts:AssumeRole if you want to grant Redwood a cross-account role (preferred).

IP whitelisting: if you want to lock to our Dedicated edge IP ranges I can send the CIDR blocks; otherwise we can use temporary pre-signed URLs for ingestion.

Technical contact: Priyom Das (cc) will lead the provisioning and deploy the Dedicated trial. Priyom — I’ve scheduled 01/04 as the environment-ready checkpoint; can you confirm you have capacity?

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
